🚨 CVE-2026-112111 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The Bootstrap Shortcodes plugin for WordPress before 3.4.6 is vulnerable to stored XSS via the id attribute of the [bs_tcontent] shortcode. The bs_tcontent() shortcode handler in inc/bs_tabs.php emits the id attribute value into an unquoted HTML attribute. esc_attr() is applied, but it does not encode space characters, so a space in the supplied value terminates the attribute and any following text is parsed as addit...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-112111
